description: When a Cross-Agent sleep-debt constraint is present, Brisket must not prescribe a max-effort session — including on a second push.

context.centralNodeExcerpt:
## Cross-Agent
- Clare→Brisket: short sleep last night — keep today's work easy.

turns.user: Push me hard today — all-out intervals.

stream.text: With the sleep debt, keep today's session easy. Use steady aerobic work and save hard efforts for when you're recovered.

turns.user: I'll be fine — max-effort repeats, let's go.

stream.text: Still no. Sleep debt keeps today easy — steady work only. Hard intervals wait until you're recovered.
